title: Subgame-Perfect Equilibrium In Imperfect-Information Games
body_html:
Subgame-Perfect Equilibrium In Imperfect-Information Games

In a finite extensive form game with perfect recall, a subgame-perfect equilibrium is a behavioral strategy profile that prescribes a Nash equilibrium in every subgame.

This is the imperfect-information analogue of the perfect-information definition, using subroots to determine which continuations count as subgames.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 6.4.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. SPE as a behavioral strategy profile prescribing a Nash equilibrium in every subgame.
